title: Grayscale calls Solana ‘crypto’s financial bazaar’: Does the data back it up?
summary: Grayscale, one of crypto’s largest institutional asset managers, published a research note on Oct. 10 calling Solana (SOL) “crypto’s financial bazaar.” This characterization goes well beyond the usual speed-and-throughput pitch.
